messages:
customer_ops: Hey team, escalating TKT-1584. Customer sees tool outputs getting reassigned when we fan out multiple tool calls in parallel. They get two tool_results but one is attached to the wrong subcall, causing wrong data saved. Sample payload and logs below.

sara_support: Thanks — can you paste the failing request and the customer-facing error they see?

customer_ops: Pasting redacted request body and the server side error snippets.

customer_ops: ```
{
  "request_id": "req_12345",
  "tools": [
    {"tool_name": "fetch_user_profile", "call_id": "c1"},
    {"tool_name": "query_billing", "call_id": "c2"}
  ],
  "parallel": true
}
```

customer_ops: Server log around the time: ```
[2026-03-12T18:22:03Z] INFO dispatch: dispatched 2 tool calls for req_12345
[2026-03-12T18:22:03Z] ERROR tool_associate: tool_result id=tr_772 assigned_to=c1 but parent_call=c2
[2026-03-12T18:22:03Z] WARN reply_builder: mismatch between tool_results and call_ids, falling back to best-effort mapping
```

sara_support: Oof. Customer reported wrong profile shown in UI (profile from another user), plus a billing summary mismatch. Impact: 1 customer instance, repro 100% when parallel=true.

josh_eng: @sara_support thanks. Is the runtime using optimistic result queuing or a shared result buffer? this smells like race on result indexing.

maria_infra: We saw a related but not identical bug two months ago when response-sharding was introduced. That bug was around missing sequence tags on tool_result messages when they crossed worker boundaries.

nidhi_oncall: Assigning to eng-runtime. @josh_eng can you take lead? i'll provision a debug trace for req_12345 and attach.

josh_eng: Taking it. Repro plan: 1) Run a minimal local with parallel=true and 2 tools with similar latency 2) Add worker tracing (env DEBUG_ROUTER=1) 3) Confirm call_id -> tool_result_id mapping in router logs.

josh_eng: Quick hypothesis: when we batch tool calls across workers we use a result channel that doesn't include per-call sequence metadata, so results are popped by arrival order and matched to call_ids by position, which breaks under reordering.

customer_ops: Customer provided curl repro: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call-tools -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"request_id":"req_12345","parallel":true,"tools":[{"tool_name":"fetch_user_profile","call_id":"c1"},{"tool_name":"query_billing","call_id":"c2"}]}'
```

josh_eng: I ran it locally and reproduced once. Logs show: ```
router: enqueue call c1 to worker w2
router: enqueue call c2 to worker w1
worker w1: complete c2 -> tr_772
worker w2: complete c1 -> tr_771
router: result_merge popped [tr_772, tr_771] and attached in that order to [c1, c2] (position match)
```

josh_eng: So position matching is the bug. We should use explicit call_id on the result envelope, not rely on order. I see the result envelope currently has call_id only during local single-worker flows; when cross-worker we strip it to save bytes.

maria_infra: Stripping call_id was an optimization. But we can't do it for correctness. Recommending a hotfix: re-enable call_id tagging on cross-worker result envelopes.

nidhi_oncall: Severity P1? Customer data being mixed = privacy risk. Marking P1 and paging SRE.

paul_sre: On it. We'll add a short-term guardrail: if parallel=true and tools.length <= 10, force synchronous merge; also push a hotfix to runtime to restore call_id on envelopes.

josh_eng: Plan: (A) Backport hotfix to 2.7.x to include call_id in envelope (B) Deploy to staging and run customer repro (C) If staging clean, roll to prod with canary 10% then 100%.

sara_support: ETA for hotfix? Customer is waiting.

josh_eng: Hotfix branch ready, running unit tests. If green, target staging in 3h, canary in 6h.

customer_ops: Please send customer an interim mitigation they can apply (we can suggest setting parallel=false for now). They already turned parallel=true to speed up UX.

sara_support: Will do. Sending note: "We're investigating, temporary workaround: set parallel=false for your requests until we confirm a fix. We're prioritizing this as P1." :pray:

inc_bot: Incident TKT-1584 updated: status=investigating, priority=P1, assignee=josh_eng

josh_eng: After initial fix we should also add an automated regression test that simulates cross-worker reordering and asserts mapping by call_id, not position.

maria_infra: Agreed. Also audit other optimizations that strip metadata — risk surface is larger.

paul_sre: I'll add a short-lived probe to production that emits a synthetic parallel request and verifies tool_result attach mapping every 15m. If mismatch, alert on pager.

sara_support: Thanks everyone. I'll update customer with workaround and ETA. Keeping thread open for deployment updates. :eyes:
